extracted.stage: Before grant of probate; IHT due prior to application
extracted.summary: A solicitor instructed by executors of an illiquid £810,000 Cheltenham estate enquires about borrowing £56,000 to pay inheritance tax before applying for the grant.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding funding for the inheritance tax liability on this estate. To take this further we would need the executors' details and confirmation of their instructions, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, and details of any property or illiquid assets forming the estate. It would also help to have the IHT calculation or account, the date by which payment is required, and confirmation of whether any other borrowing or charges exist over the estate. Once we have those documents a member of our team will review the enquiry and come back to you. Please do let us know if you have any questions in the meantime.
